entries.text: Hi, it's Mia from Replogle Globes. Thanks for taking a few minutes with me: your code, $20 off,
That's right, twenty dollars off, and it shows up on your screen when we're done. So what brings you to Replogle Globes today?
I was looking for a World Globe. But first of all, what is this on my screen? It says Shrine. This store is running authorized... Unauthorized copy of Shrine.

I can't see that message from my side, so I'm not sure what it means. For anything about the store itself, (email hidden) is the right place to ask. Meanwhile, is the world globe for you or for someone else?
Oh, it's for someone else. It's for my kid.
A gift for your kid, lovely. How old is your kid, and what do they like to do with maps or learning about places?
Well, they actually... They're twenty four, and they're studying geography at university. So pretty relevant.
Studying geography, so a world globe fits well. What matters most to you in choosing it: how it looks, the detail on the map, or the price?
For sure, the details and how well you can see them.
Detail and clarity, got it. Are you comparing Replogle Globes with other stores or brands as well?
